prompt:
Subject, retro screen-print fashion illustration × independent publication poster × geometric figure design × VOXCAT brand visual.

Retain the character's most recognizable hairstyle silhouette, main color palette, clothing features, and representative accessories, but redesign them into a clean, modern fashion look. Proportions are naturally slender, using static editorial poses like side-standing, leaning, turning, looking back, crossing arms, or holding props, automatically adapted to character temperament.

The visual uses 3-4 high-recognition spot colors, establishing a primary color system based on character colors. It features hard-edged flat painting, coarse halftone dots, screen-printing ink layers, slight registration misalignment, local ink build-up, and paper fiber texture. Outlines are bold and geometric; details are highly generalized using large color blocks and silhouettes, without soft digital gouache effects.

The background uses asymmetrical geometric composition, organizing the layout with large circles, rectangles, arcs, cropped color blocks, and whitespace. Characters interact with geometric shapes through overlapping and crossing, creating a 1960s–1970s retro commercial print × contemporary independent art poster aesthetic.

Incorporate VOXCAT brand elements: a stylized “V” cat-ear/tail geometric logo in the top left; a small handwritten “voxCAT” signature in the bottom right; a subtle woven tag or embroidery on clothing; and minimal serial numbers as design elements. 

Vertical main visual, large whitespace, 3-4 spot color printing, coarse dots, registration offset, paper grain, geometric blocks, strong silhouettes, simple and premium independent art print quality.
